facts.fact: Tris 进教堂圣所前先关上门，靠这个动作确认手指还在动——她感觉不到自己的手。
facts.anchor: I close the door behind me before I move into the church sanctuary

facts.fact: 父亲两手按在她肩上，她退开不是因为臂上的伤口疼，而是那份把她往下拽的重量。
facts.anchor: The weight of his hands, dragging me down when I’m already so heavy, is unbearable.

facts.fact: 父亲明白妻子已死，脸垮下来，嘴张开、眼睛空掉，像他的偶人。
facts.anchor: His face falls. Mouth gone slack, eyes empty.

facts.fact: Tobias 从黑暗里出现，把她从父亲和 Caleb 身边带走，让她坐下。
facts.anchor: Tobias materializes from the dark, like I dreamed him into being.

facts.fact: Marcus 递出的是自己身上那件衬衫，Tobias 接过撕成布条给她绑伤口。
facts.anchor: It’s his shirt—he still has an undershirt on, with his gray jacket over it

facts.fact: Tobias 检查伤口，说子弹应该是穿透了，又点她的肩说那是出口。
facts.anchor: I think the bullet went right through you

facts.fact: 她以策划者的思路推断模拟室不会无人看守，于是带人贴墙靠近廊角。
facts.anchor: But if I was Jeanine Matthews, planning this kind of attack, I wouldn’t leave the simulation unguarded.

facts.fact: 章末 Caleb 脱下夹克掏出枪，枪口对准 Tobias 的后脑。
facts.anchor: He points it at the back of Tobias’s head.
